code_paths.finding: generate passes the decoded response to _response and returns only extracted text, model, provider, and finish_reason.
Documentation JSON mode maps to response_format={type: json_object}.
The adapter reads only choices[0].message.content; reasoning_content and other alternate fields are ignored. Missing, non-string, or blank content fails before documentation parsing.
The HTTP layer decodes the top-level JSON object but does not persist the raw response envelope.
Documentation requests structured JSON; finish_reason=length is converted to output_truncated before parser validation. Persian retry occurs only after a parsed result fails the script check.
The parser requires valid JSON, exactly eight top-level fields, and an exact ordered parameter-name list.

adapter_replay.interpretation: This proves adapter capability, not the shape of the historical GLM responses. The historical raw envelopes were not saved.

documentation_parser_replay.reason: saved JSON ends at notes without a value or closing object; production flow would classify output_truncated before parsing
saved JSON ends inside a string; production flow would classify output_truncated before parsing

qa_documentation_contrast.interpretation: The failure is concentrated in structured Documentation rather than a uniform provider outage. The artifacts do not isolate model, provider JSON mode, or alternate-field extraction as the sole cause.

provider_truly_empty.evidence: Four GLM records contain invalid_response_empty_content, but no raw choices/message envelope was retained.

adapter_can_discard_reasoning_content.evidence: The adapter reads message.content only. Offline replay rejects reasoning-only envelopes, but historical envelopes are unavailable.

validator_rejected_valid_output.evidence: The current parser accepted all five complete Qwen JSON outputs and rejected only three visibly incomplete JSON outputs. Four GLM cases had no text to validate.

truncation.evidence: CB-DOC-H-FA and CB-DOC-B-FA record finish_reason=length and end with incomplete JSON.

schema_contract_pressure.evidence: Documentation uses an eight-field exact JSON contract and JSON response mode. GLM QA succeeded 6/6 while GLM Documentation produced no complete JSON; Qwen produced one incomplete complex Persian Documentation output.

missing_deterministic_facts.evidence: Fact coverage may affect semantic quality, but cannot explain empty message content or length-truncated JSON.

decision_gate.next_step: If approved, capture sanitized raw response field presence for the fixed 2-model x 2-language x 2-symbol diagnostic without changing prompts or scoring. Contract redesign should remain deferred until that diagnostic.

limitations: Raw OpenAI-compatible response envelopes were not stored.
Token usage is unavailable for all Qwen and GLM cases.
GLM result records do not include the exact input object; frozen Qwen inputs and matching benchmark/evidence hashes were used only to recover expected parameter names for offline parser replay.

The recorded glm_results generation metadata says external_provider_called=false despite containing GLM outputs; this provenance inconsistency does not change the per-case replay findings but should not be used as proof of call history.
